div.p: • Authentication ≠ object authorization. An authenticated user can still be unauthorized or submit invalid amounts.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; color: rgb(29, 29, 29); color-scheme: dark; interactivity: inert; margin-block: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-top: 0px; min-block-size: 30px; min-height: 30px; row-rule-color: rgb(29, 29, 29); text-rendering: optimizelegibility;

div.p: • User claim ≠ counterparty acknowledgement ≠ bank/payment-network verification. Phittoos does not move funds.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; color: rgb(29, 29, 29); color-scheme: dark; interactivity: inert; margin-block: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-top: 0px; min-block-size: 30px; min-height: 30px; row-rule-color: rgb(29, 29, 29); text-rendering: optimizelegibility;

div.p: • No private V1 history upload, auto-match, or shared permission from knowing a friend's name.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; color: rgb(29, 29, 29); color-scheme: dark; interactivity: inert; margin-block: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-top: 0px; min-block-size: 30px; min-height: 30px; row-rule-color: rgb(29, 29, 29); text-rendering: optimizelegibility;

div.p: • Offline/pending operations do not alter confirmed shared money; replay and concurrent writes require atomic guards.

p.style: box-sizing: border-box; color: rgb(29, 29, 29); color-scheme: dark; interactivity: inert; margin-block: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; margin-top: 0px; min-block-size: 30px; min-height: 30px; row-rule-color: rgb(29, 29, 29); text-rendering: optimizelegibility;

div.p: • Revocation affects future authorized access; retention of existing accepted history and cached/exported copies must be explicitly specified.
